description: Grade one trip offer for ride-hail drivers (Uber, inDrive, DiDi, Cabify, Yango) in Colombia, Peru and Bolivia, the way the Drivaron app does: pay per km and per hour with the pickup included, an A+/A/B/C grade against the driver's hourly target, and the minimum fare to ask for (inDrive counteroffer floor). Use it when a driver asks whether an offer is worth taking or what to charge.

city.description: City, which sets currency, starting hourly target and average speed. One of: Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Lima, Arequipa, Trujillo, Santa Cruz de la Sierra, La Paz, Cochabamba.

commission_pct.description: Platform commission in % taken from the fare, if the fare shown is before commission (e.g. 10 for inDrive). Default 0.

country.description: Country when the city is unknown: Colombia (CO, COP), Peru (PE, PEN) or Bolivia (BO, BOB).

currency.description: Currency, when neither city nor country is known.

fare.description: Fare shown in the offer, in local currency (e.g. 14000 COP, 14 PEN, 28 BOB).

fuel_cost_per_km.description: Fuel cost per km, to show profit after fuel.

lang.description: Language of the summary: es (default) or en.

pickup_km.description: Distance to the passenger in km. Unpaid, so it lowers real pay per km.

pickup_min.description: Minutes to reach the passenger, if shown. Otherwise estimated from speed.

speed_kmh.description: Average city speed in km/h. Defaults to the city's value.

target_per_hour.description: Driver's hourly earnings goal in local currency. Defaults to the city's starting target.

tip.description: Tip or bonus included with the offer.

trip_km.description: Trip distance in km (pickup point to destination).

trip_min.description: Trip duration in minutes, if the offer shows it. Otherwise estimated from speed.

name: grade_ride_offer

app.description: The Drivaron app and its Play download link.

color.description: green, yellow or red for offers.

result.description: All numbers, raw and formatted in local currency.

summary.description: One-paragraph answer in the requested language, ready to show the driver.

title: Is this trip worth it?
